subject: all
body: Heads-up: a 'git pull/rebase --autostash' at 13:07 PT left its autostash unapplied (stash@{0}), reverting uncommitted tracked files. Restored from it: autoresearch/taste/scrape.py, tests/test_scrape_exa.py, data/researchers/ethan_cai/seed_choices.jsonl, synthme/*. stash@{0} is left in place. Please check the output says 'Applied autostash' after rebasing, and don't autostash while runs write tracked files.
